At 83, Dottie loved riding her Harley-Davidson, sometimes with a cape flowing behind her. Here, she poses with Willow, her pet raccoon, who photographer Robin de Puy says was often perched on her shoulder or curled in her lap. Dottie was a former teacher in the tiny town of Uncertain, Texas, where she was known as “Superwoman.” De Puy met Dottie three years before her death in 2025 while traveling across the United States for AMERICAN, a collection of photographs, films, and audio portraits documenting the lives and experiences of people she encountered during her travels.
